items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers remote code execution (RCE) in Magento and Adobe Commerce. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this critical vulnerability, which has a CVSS score of 10.0 and is actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Security Update - Security Feature Bypass/Privilege Escalation
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, part of the APSB26-138 security update, addresses a security feature bypass and privilege escalation issue in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to elevated privileges or bypassing security controls.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Security Update - Security Feature Bypass/Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical vulnerability resolved in APSB26-138, this issue involves a security feature bypass and privilege escalation in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Exploitation could allow an attacker to gain higher privileges or circumvent security measures.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Security Update - Security Feature Bypass/Privilege Escalation
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, part of the APSB26-138 bulletin, addresses a security feature bypass and privilege escalation flaw in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to unauthorized access or elevated privileges.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Security Update - Security Feature Bypass/Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical vulnerability included in APSB26-138, this issue allows for security feature bypass and privilege escalation in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Exploitation could result in an attacker gaining unauthorized access or higher privileges.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Security Update - Security Feature Bypass/Privilege Escalation
items.summary: An important vulnerability addressed in APSB26-138, this issue concerns a security feature bypass and privilege escalation in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Exploitation could lead to bypassing security features or gaining elevated privileges.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update (Unauthenticated Account Takeover)
items.summary: This security update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities in Amasty Magento Extensions
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of its Magento extensions, with two critical vulnerabilities identified. These critical issues can lead to remote code execution on affected Magento stores.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in. This vulnerability opens the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: This authorization bypass vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows a low-privileged authenticated attacker to bypass a security feature and read select data. The flaw affects multiple versions and exploitation occurs over the network without user interaction.

items.title: Critical Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension. This critical vulnerability could lead to remote code execution.
